pr_title: API: Return primary language and repository language stats API URL
pr_body:
Adds two new properties for Repository structure `langauge` and `languages_url` (named same as in GitHub API)

Fixes #18395

issue_context.title: Add a top language(s) field to `Repository`
issue_context.body:
### Feature Description

Currently `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/languages` is the only way to access this information. However, I am already calling `GET /users/{username}/repos` and would like to avoid the extra request if possible. Don't need the full statistics, just name(s) would suffice.

### Screenshots

_No response_

review_comments: it just wraps real error and should not be that verbose, also it does use same wording as in RepositoryList.LoadAttributes
so that error chain can be easier to trace
Is it possible to avoid using a slice? Given it's only 1 entry.
That would require introducing duplicate code for `LanguageStat` attributes with no real gain. (`LanguageStatList` has `LoadAttributes` while `LanguageStat` does not have)
